svg.title: Zero-downtime container platform on AWS ECS Fargate
svg.desc: A build-and-deliver pipeline feeds a Terraform-provisioned AWS region where an application load balancer path-routes to nginx frontend and Node backend Fargate tasks across two availability zones, with a CloudWatch and Application Auto Scaling control loop that scales one to four tasks.
svg.text: Zero-downtime container platform on AWS ECS Fargate
Terraform-provisioned · GitHub Actions with OIDC federation · multi-AZ Fargate · CPU-driven auto scaling
34 resources from a single apply — VPC · subnets · ALB · target groups · ECS · IAM · auto scaling · log groups
